entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can refresh your spell-like abilities by expending spell energy.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane spellcaster, caster level 4th, serpentfolk.

Benefit(s): You can expend two arcane spell slots or prepared spells to cast one of your racial spell-like abilities. The level of each expended spell must be equal to or higher than the sorcerer/wizard spell level of the spell-like ability you want to cast.
